steps.text: FairMind opens on Home. Down the left edge, seven icons stand for the groups of pages.
Choosing a group opens its first page and lists the rest in the panel beside it. Inventory holds your AI systems and what discovery found.
Testing holds the evaluations you choose, the runs, and agent audits.
Search reaches every page and every system. Command K opens it from anywhere.
Type a system or a page name and pick it to go straight there.
In the demo, everything can be opened and nothing can be changed.
